question: What will be the result of the France vs Italy UEFA Nations League match on 2 October 2026?

calls.reasoning: Anchor: League A league-phase results run about 44% home / 26% draw / 29% away (34 matches counted from 2024/25 Groups 1-3). Conditioning on a clearly stronger home side shifts that to roughly 57/24/19, and an independent Poisson check with France ~1.8 xG and Italy ~0.95 xG away gives 55/24/21 - the two methods agree. The quality gap is genuinely wide now: France were World Cup semi-finalists with Mbappe, Dembele, Olise, Doue and Barcola available, while Italy missed a third straight World Cup on penalties to Bosnia and are starting over under Mancini with nine new call-ups and four injured regulars out. I shaded back toward the unconditional rate because Zidane's system is untested in competition, this is France's third match in eight days after two away trips, Saliba/Tchouameni/Thuram are absent, and Italy won 3-1 in Paris as underdogs only two years ago - Mancini's first Italy spell was built on being hard to beat, which supports the elevated draw share. Non-completion is small: UEFA senior competitive fixtures at major venues almost never go unplayed, and the fine print counts an awarded forfeit as a win/loss rather than non-completion.
